entities.summary: Amaya Valdemoro Madariaga is a Spanish former basketball player. She won three Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) championship rings with the Houston Comets, one EuroLeague title with Dorna Godella, as well as eight Spanish league title and one Russian Premier League title. She was the Russian League Player of the Year in 2006.
